title: Decision tree as a sum of path indicators
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $T$ be a decision tree on the binary cube $\\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with real-valued leaves, and let $f:\\mathbb{F}_2^n\\to\\mathbb{R}$ be the function computed by $T$. For each path $P$ of $T$, write $a_P$ for its leaf output and let $1_P(x)$ be $1$ if $x$ agrees with every coordinate assignment fixed along $P$, and $0$ otherwise. Then, for every $x\\in\\mathbb{F}_2^n$, $f(x)=\\sum_P a_P 1_P(x)$, where the sum ranges over all paths of $T$.
